clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Fishing directs aspiring anglers to discover how their patience with a rod and line can elevate wilderness expeditions. By seeking out Fenn Fairweather in Shen'dar Village, proficient fishermen can learn to craft a decorative Fish Bowl fixture to bolster morale and camp comfort.

Life in the wilderness demands more than sharp blades and sturdy armor; keeping morale high in the field can mean the difference between triumph and exhaustion. While fishing is often treated purely as a quiet pastime or a means to harvest provisions, skilled anglers can turn their craft toward improving campsite comfort. By capturing live fish and preparing dedicated fixtures, a traveler can transform a bleak encampment into a welcoming sanctuary.

In Shen'dar Village, the artisan Fenn Fairweather shares trade secrets with seasoned fishermen who understand the patience of the rod and reel. Those who demonstrate sufficient skill can learn to fashion a Fish Bowl—a simple camp fixture designed to bring cheer and relaxation to weary companions. Maintaining high spirits out in the wilds helps keep party members focused and resolute when facing looming dangers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can teach you once you've gained some skill as a fisherman.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
